reviews.review: One of the best co-op shooters I've played with one of the best communities I've ever had the pleasure of being a part of. Rock and Stone, Brothers!

ROCK AND STONE!
Come for the gold, stay for BOSCO. A wonderfully friendly community and lovingly crafted game make this extremely replayable and tons of fun, solo or with friends.
Dwarves drinking beer in outer space and mining rock and stone while blackout drunk. Love it!

This game offers a perfect blend of business and relaxation that fits any and all players.
Are you a master of this genre and want to be pushed to your limits? Get some levels and enter the appropriately named Hazard 5 - Lethal difficulty and experience the worst the planet can throw at you!
Are you new to this kind of game and just want to relax with friends? The lower difficulties are forgiving yet satisfyingly challenging, and the community is less toxic than a box of crayons.

On the topic of the community, the simple to use/overuse V key is a UNIVERSAL language and reaction. 
Did your Scout absolutely LAUNCH himself off a cliff to his demise? ROCK AND STONE!
Found 3 massive gold chunks in one room? ROCK AND STONE!(x4)
"""Accidentally""" trigger a bulk detonator catastrophically downing two teammates? ROCK AND STONE TO THE BONE!

Welcome to DRG, and remember, last one to load in buys the next round for the party!

Likes:
- Tons of replayability. Nearly 300 hours in and I'm still getting cosmetics and overlocks for my weapons.
- Fun solo player experience, with helper robot and ability to pause.
- Even MORE fun 4 player co-op experience, with one of the best communities out there (and the occasional toxic leaf-lover)
- 4 unique classes, with perks, gun mods, overlocks, different grenades... tons of customization to play what best suits you.
- Proc gen caves are unique every time, and still feel pretty fresh even after several hundred hours
- Continued development from the devs (new missions types soon)

Dislikes:
- Proc gen very rarely causes some issues with mission essential minerals getting hidden behind black ice and other things
- Occasional weird physics glitches may yeet you across the cave. 
- ...can't really think of any more.

TL;DR Good solo game, good multiplayer game, good price, if you're on the fence buy it and enjoy.
